en.swap_desc_zram:
ZRAM (Active RAM Compression):
Compresses data blocks in real time in physical RAM using the ultra-fast zstd algorithm (with dynamic allocation up to 50% of RAM).

Benefits:
- Significantly increases effective RAM capacity.
- Prevents system freezes and Out-Of-Memory (OOM) crashes.
- Zero disk write cycles, preserving SSD and NVMe drive lifespan.
en.swap_desc_file_auto:
Dynamic Swap File:
Automatically creates a /swapfile on disk sized based on detected physical RAM for contingency and paging.
en.swap_desc_file_2g:
Swap File (2 GB):
Creates a fixed 2 GB swap file on the root filesystem for contingency and paging.
en.swap_desc_file_4g:
Swap File (4 GB):
Creates a fixed 4 GB swap file on the root filesystem for contingency and paging.
en.swap_desc_file_8g:
Swap File (8 GB):
Creates a fixed 8 GB swap file on the root filesystem for hibernation and heavy workloads.
en.swap_desc_none:
Disabled (No Swap):
No swap space will be created. All execution will rely strictly on physical RAM.
en.de_desc_cli: Pure Shell Mode: Minimal installation without graphical interface, ideal for servers, IoT or advanced users.
en.de_desc_xfce: XFCE 4.18: Extremely fast, stable, and lightweight on RAM. Great for maximum performance.
en.de_desc_gnome: GNOME 48: Modern, fluid interface with intuitive gesture navigation and elegant design.
en.de_desc_kde: KDE Plasma 6: Highly customizable, modern, with advanced visual effects and stellar performance.
en.de_desc_cinnamon: Cinnamon: Traditional desktop layout, ideal for users who prefer classic usability.
en.de_desc_mate: MATE: Classic continuation of GNOME 2, focused on simplicity and resource efficiency.
en.de_desc_lxqt: LXQt: Lightweight Qt-based environment, focused on speed and ultra-low RAM footprint.
en.slide1_desc: The NextFerret Snapshot Manager creates LVM Thin restoration points in under 2 seconds. Keep your data and root system secure without interrupting workflow.
en.slide2_desc: NAPT executes package management with active Seccomp syscall filtering, blocking 22 dangerous system calls for rock-solid stability.
en.slide3_desc: The NextFerret Linux Chroots manages isolated Chroots in /nsm/chroots, letting you run software without risking host system corruption.
en.slide4_desc: The ultra-fast zstd algorithm dynamically expands effective RAM capacity with zero disk wear, extending SSD and NVMe lifespan.
en.slide5_desc: Combining the rock-solid stability and vast software ecosystem of Debian with the modern performance and custom tools of Arvor Linux.

pt.swap_zram: ZRAM (Compactação de RAM via zstd - Recomendado)
pt.swap_desc_zram:
ZRAM (Compactação Ativa na RAM):
Compacta blocos de dados em tempo real na memória física usando o algoritmo ultrarrápido zstd (com limite dinâmico de até 50% da RAM).

Benefícios:
- Multiplica a capacidade útil da memória RAM.
- Evita congelamentos e falhas por esgotamento de memória (OOM).
- Zero ciclos de escrita em disco, preservando a vida útil de SSDs e NVMe.
pt.swap_desc_file_auto:
Arquivo Swap Dinâmico:
Cria automaticamente um arquivo /swapfile no disco dimensionado de acordo com a memória RAM física detectada para contingência e paginação tradicional.
pt.swap_desc_file_2g:
Arquivo Swap (2 GB):
Cria um arquivo fixo de troca de 2 GB no disco raiz para contingência e paginação.
pt.swap_desc_file_4g:
Arquivo Swap (4 GB):
Cria um arquivo fixo de troca de 4 GB no disco raiz para contingência e paginação.
pt.swap_desc_file_8g:
Arquivo Swap (8 GB):
Cria um arquivo fixo de troca de 8 GB no disco raiz para suporte a cargas intensas ou hibernação.
pt.swap_desc_none:
Desativado (Sem Swap):
Não cria área de troca. Toda a execução ocorrerá estritamente na memória RAM física.

pt.de_desc_mate: MATE: Continuação clássica do GNOME 2, com foco na simplicidade e eficiência de recursos.

ZRAM (Aktive RAM-Komprimierung):
Komprimiert Datenblöcke in Echtzeit im physischen RAM mit zstd (dynamisch bis zu 50% des RAMs).

Vorteile:
- Erhöht die nutzbare RAM-Kapazität erheblich.
- Verhindert Einfrieren und Abstürze durch Speichermangel (OOM).
- Keine Festplattenschreibzyklen, schont die Lebensdauer von SSD und NVMe.

Erstellt automatisch eine an den physischen RAM angepasste /swapfile auf der Festplatte.

Erstellt eine feste 2 GB Swap-Datei auf der Root-Partition.
de.swap_desc_file_4g:
Swap-Datei (4 GB):
Erstellt eine feste 4 GB Swap-Datei auf der Root-Partition.
de.swap_desc_file_8g:
Swap-Datei (8 GB):
Erstellt eine feste 8 GB Swap-Datei für Ruhezustand und schwere Arbeitslasten.
de.swap_desc_none:
Deaktiviert (Kein Swap):
Kein Swap-Bereich. Das System arbeitet ausschließlich mit physischem RAM.

de.de_desc_cinnamon: Cinnamon: Traditionelles Desktop-Layout für klassische Bedienung.
de.de_desc_mate: MATE: Klassische Fortführung von GNOME 2 mit Fokus auf Einfachheit und Effizienz.
de.de_desc_lxqt: LXQt: Leichtgewichtige Qt-Umgebung mit extrem niedrigem RAM-Verbrauch.
de.slide1_desc: Der NextFerret Snapshot Manager erstellt LVM Thin Wiederherstellungspunkte in unter 2 Sekunden.
de.slide2_desc: NAPT isoliert Installationen mit Seccomp und blockiert 22 gefährliche Syscalls für maximale Stabilität.
